node.statement: Because n>=1, H=C^n is a nonzero finite-dimensional Hilbert space.  Node 1.2 gives that Phi is UCP and has cb defect at most eta, while 0<=eta<=eta_K and node 1.1 give eta<=rho_id^corr; hence every input hypothesis of lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation is met for this exact triple (C^n,Phi,eta) and the fixed W_RF.
